scope: Chess hub and measured capacity hardening

api: Registered devs receive editable hub controls and permanent labels
Shared guest bootstrap ignores a dev cookie and omits dev/private authority
Three concurrent retries create one topic with one permanent IL
A public UUID cannot steal a private cloud identity or its IL
Author, dev and expected-account checks reject cross-account changes
Following is private to the signed-in account
Reports are visible only to registered devs
Replies deduplicate, keep separate ILs and size by actual descendant characters
Topic and reply ILs resolve without signing in
Closing a discussion stops new replies and can be reversed
Competing edits cannot overwrite a newer version
Hidden replies disappear from public reads and IL navigation
Deletion undo is signed, account-bound and version-bound
All eight existing variants still start with native legal moves and complete geometry
Paid variants still require an authoritative purchase
Concurrent cached board reads preserve the same authoritative version
Six simultaneous engine requests commit exactly one legal reply
Code matchmaking, account-only seats and agreed draws stay authoritative
A cancel/join race cannot cancel a game after it starts
Undo really expires after its original ten-second window
Dev settings and measured return usage are available without changing limits

staticAudit.disposition: 38 previously reviewed findings retained; six new regex false positives (four Button-asChild navigation actions, two canonical Textarea disableResize controls). Not a clean strict-audit pass.

capacity.measurement: First observed signed-in Chess play, return on a later UTC day within seven days. Cohorts mature after seven days. Reserved QA users excluded.

constraints: Published-origin API and browser checks; preview sandbox returned a policy 403 and was not bypassed.
Phone emulation, desktop and short landscape checked; physical iPhone and native keyboard/store tests not performed.
Daily Time earning still requires its established 15-second financial lease; this is a separately quantified launch bottleneck.
k6 script is staging-only; planning figures are not measured capacity.

work.basis: Observed elapsed agent implementation/testing interval. Not independently verified human labor. No historical time invented; post-close release bookkeeping excluded.
